name: Player Avatar (3D)
description: 3D appearance chosen in the creator: species, hair, face, skin, build, calling outfit.
behaviorRules: Client-owned. Never write this variable. Read player-appearance for prose descriptions.

name: 3D World State
description: Fog-of-war bitmap (run-length encoded, 5-mile cells), recently slain monster populations and the saved turn-based encounter, if one is in progress.
behaviorRules: Client-owned engine bookkeeping. Never write this variable.

name: 3D Character Models
description: Optional glTF/GLB character and creature models for the 3D client: a map from a model slot to a world asset, for example {"humanoid": {"asset": "@asset:<uuid>"}, "creature:canine": {"asset": "@asset:<uuid>"}}. Empty means the built-in procedural characters are used.
